notes: 0.3.60：修复 B 机拉取后会话没有归入对应工作区。根因是两个叠加问题：(1) apply.ps1 的 Sync-WorkspaceApply 合并且只采用 workspace-registry.json 快照里的 sessionIds，没有把 conversations/sessions/--ws-<id>--/<sid>/ 目录反推出的会话 id 补进各工作区的 sessionIds；(2) settings 段又把仓库里 settings/dsh-workspaces.json 旧快照整份写回 storages/workspace.json，把刚补全的 sessionIds 打回原样。本版在合并阶段按会话目录反推把 sid 并入 sessionIds，并让工作区登记表由 Sync-WorkspaceApply 独家负责、不再被旧快照覆盖。隔离环境实测 sessionIds 由 16 增至 54（覆盖 54/56，剩 2 个属于 A 机注册表里不存在的幽灵工作区，属正常例外），会话首帧 cwd 修正 46、projcache 修正 46、bundle 24 项全可解析。0.3.59 及以前的功能（apply.ps1 UTF8-BOM、仓库改名、projcache 目录反推、dsh-purge 1.4.0 对齐）全部保留。产物 releases\dsh-config-sync-plugin-0.3.60.tgz。
notesEn: 0.3.60: fix sessions not being filed under their workspaces on the B machine after pull. Two stacked causes: (1) Sync-WorkspaceApply merged only the sessionIds from the workspace-registry.json snapshot and never added session ids inferred from conversations/sessions/--ws-<id>--/<sid>/ folders into each workspace sessionIds; (2) the settings block then overwrote storages/workspace.json wholesale with the stale settings/dsh-workspaces.json snapshot, reverting the just-augmented sessionIds. This build infers sids from session folders into sessionIds during merge, and makes the workspace registry owned solely by Sync-WorkspaceApply so the stale snapshot no longer clobbers it. Isolated replay: sessionIds 16 -> 54 (54/56 coverage; the 2 remaining belong to a ghost workspace absent from the A-machine registry, an expected exception), 46 session-header cwd fixes, 46 projcache fixes, all 24 bundles resolvable. All 0.3.59-and-earlier features retained (apply.ps1 UTF8-BOM, repo rename, projcache folder inference, dsh-purge 1.4.0 alignment). Artifact releases\dsh-config-sync-plugin-0.3.60.tgz.
